name: com.adeel.unitytoolbox
description: A curated toolbox of battle-tested Unity runtime scripts and editor tools: object pooling, singletons, slow motion, FPS counter, UI anchor fixing, bootstrap scene automation, Android version-code incrementing, asset audits and more.

samples.description: Email/password registration and sign-in with a role stored in the Realtime Database. Requires the Firebase Unity SDK.
Webcam QR scanning into a TextMeshPro label. Requires ZXing.Net.
Pinch-to-zoom and mouse-wheel zoom built on the Unity Input System package.
Background-music and sound-effect manager with a ready-made prefab.
Example of migrating a legacy JSON payload into a new schema. Adapt to your own data.
Inject keystore and key-alias passwords from environment variables so they never live in the project.
Standalone .bat that deletes the regenerable Library folder from every Unity project under a directory.
